modules.title: 同一候选版本怎样经过本地、预发布再到生产
预发布环境为什么单独存在

items.title: 在生产前复现关键部署条件
items.text: 预发布环境尽量使用接近生产的构建、配置和依赖，方便发现只在真实部署后出现的问题；同时用独立地址、测试账号和脱敏或专用数据，避免影响真实订单。

items.title: 叫 Staging 不等于已经足够安全
items.text: 上线前仍要核对实际版本、数据连接、密钥、外部服务和访问范围。一个环境只有名字像预发布，却仍连着生产数据，不能作为安全验证场所。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Staging 是测试环境的一类，不是“测试环境”的同义词。本地环境和 CI 临时环境也能用于测试，但通常不承担生产前的近生产验证；Staging 也不是生产副本，必须隔离真实用户和敏感数据。

lessonPractice.title: 团队准备测试“删除订单”功能。下面哪个环境安排更安全且更能提供有效证据？

options.label: 在独立预发布环境用测试或脱敏订单执行，确认候选版本、近生产配置和删除结果
options.feedback: 对。它能验证接近生产的完整流程，又不会删除真实用户订单。

options.label: 在生产找一条真实订单删除，确认功能确实能用
options.feedback: 破坏性操作会影响真实用户和数据，不能用它作为普通验收手段。

options.label: 只在开发者本机看一眼按钮，不需要任何数据或配置验证
options.feedback: 本地外观不能证明部署后的配置和服务连接正确。

en.title: The team plans to test “delete order.” Which environment arrangement is safer and gives useful evidence?

options.label: Use test or de-identified orders in isolated staging, confirming the candidate version, production-like configuration, and deletion result
options.feedback: Correct. It tests a production-like full flow without deleting a real customer order.

options.label: Delete one real production order to prove the feature works
options.feedback: A destructive action can affect real users and data and is not ordinary acceptance evidence.

options.label: Only inspect the button on a developer machine, with no data or configuration check
options.feedback: Local appearance does not prove deployed configuration and service connections are right.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把候选版本部署到独立预发布环境，用测试或脱敏数据验证删除订单。告诉我 Staging 地址、运行版本、与生产接近的配置、数据类型和删除后的可观察结果；不要在生产执行破坏性测试。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Deploy the candidate version to isolated staging and verify order deletion with test or de-identified data. Report the staging URL, running version, production-like configuration, data type, and observable deletion result; do not run destructive testing in production.

learning.assumes: You know one project can run locally, at a test URL, and at a live URL.
learning.outcome: You can tell whether an environment truly sits before production and name its configuration, data, and access differences from local work and production.

modules.title: How one candidate moves from local work through staging to production

items.title: Reproduce key deployment conditions before production
items.text: Staging uses a production-like build, configuration, and dependencies to reveal deployed-flow problems, while separate URLs, accounts, and de-identified data protect real users.

items.title: The label Staging is not safety proof
items.text: Verify the actual version, data connection, keys, external services, and access. An environment named staging but connected to production data is not a safe verification boundary.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Staging is one kind of test environment, not a synonym for every test environment. Local and CI-ephemeral environments can run tests but usually do not provide the production-like, pre-release role of staging. Staging also needs isolation from real users and sensitive data.

distinctions.label: Deployment
distinctions.text: {c:staging} is one kind of target environment used to validate a version. {c:deployment} is the act of placing a version into testing, production, or another environment.
